fail_safe_rule: INCLUDE or UNCERTAIN => load; EXCLUDE with confidence < 0.30 => load

rationale.ROUTING: required in every sealed engineering task; semantic gating adds risk without value
rationale.SUBAGENTS: small fragment and poor discrimination in sealed replay; always-load is cheaper than semantic gating
rationale.repo_local_core: small 149-191 token-equivalent sections; savings are too small to justify semantic admission risk
rationale.AGENT_REACH: large and low-frequency; semantic relevance is not reliably captured by path/keyword rules
rationale.EGO_BROWSER: largest low-frequency skill and strongest observed admission candidate
rationale.BEST_MINDS: large optional skill; sealed set had no positive case, so fresh positive coverage is required

qualification_note: This policy is a post-sealed hypothesis. It must be evaluated only on fresh tasks that were not used in calibration or sealed selection, and must not be changed based on those results.
